## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `UsageDashboards`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `usage-dashboards`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **UsageDashboards**.

## Step 2: Download custom reports

1. <!-- manual: In the API field, select one or more APIs for which you want to generate the report. If required, you can select all the APIs by selecting All. -->
2. <!-- manual: If you need to further filter the content printed in the report, select one or more applications in the Consumer field. By default, all applications that have subscribed to one or more of the selected APIs are selected. :::tip If you want to filter the report content by the API consumer instead of the application, click the toggle switch to the right of the Consumer field, then select the required consumer. Only consumers who have subscribed to one or more of the selected APIs are displayed in the list. You can either select one or all of them. ::: -->
3. <!-- manual: Select the required year and the month in the Year and Month fields to specify the time interval for which you want to generate the report. -->
4. Select **Download** and select the required format.

## Step 3: Generate a custom report

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Usage Insights page under Insights, then Usage in the left navigation menu. -->
2. In the left sub-navigation menu of **Usage Insights**, select **Custom Reports**.
3. <!-- manual: Select metrics from the Metrics drop-down selector. -->
4. <!-- manual: Select between 1 and 3 group-by fields from the Group By drop-down selector. -->
5. <!-- manual: Set the order of the group-by filters by drag-and-drop to determine the grouping order of the selected metrics. -->
6. Once you determine the order of the group-by fields, you can set values for each group-by field from the respective drop-down.
7. Select **Generate**.
